integrity: Complete symbolic proof using strict concavity, symmetry, convex rounding, precise slacks and positive KKT multipliers. No independent scientific verification.
scientific_limitations: Real finite metric Lipschitz dual balls, even n>=4, equal within-pair t in [1,2], canonical mean-zero Euclidean coordinates. Possible unindexed equivalent prior result. Finite checks do not prove infinite range.
title: Exact Löwner ellipsoids and contact transitions for matched-pair Lipschitz metrics
